instruction: The deployment config merger on the second Linux machine is applying layers in the wrong order. Use `/tmp/config/spec.json` on the first machine to repair `/tmp/config/project/merge_config.py`, run the supplied `/tmp/config/project/tests.py`, and save its console output as `/tmp/config/project/test.txt`.

result.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import copy,importlib.util
try:
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('merge_config','/tmp/config/project/merge_config.py'); module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module); merge=module.merge
 cases=[
  ({'debug':True,'db':{'host':'base','port':1},'keep':'yes'},{'db':{'host':'env','pool':4},'region':'west'},{'debug':None,'db':{'port':9},'region':'east'},{'db':{'host':'env','port':9,'pool':4},'keep':'yes','region':'east'}),
  ({'service':{'db':{'host':'base','options':{'ssl':False,'timeout':10}}},'features':['base'],'mode':'base'},{'service':{'db':{'options':{'ssl':True},'pool':4}},'features':['environment']},{'service':{'db':{'host':'override','options':{'timeout':None}}},'features':['override'],'mode':{'kind':'safe'}},{'service':{'db':{'host':'override','options':{'ssl':True},'pool':4}},'features':['override'],'mode':{'kind':'safe'}}),
  ({'a':{'b':{'c':1,'keep':2}}},{},{'a':{'b':{'c':None}}},{'a':{'b':{'keep':2}}}),
  ({'value':{'nested':1}},{'value':['replacement']},{'value':'final'},{'value':'final'}),
 ]
 ok=True
 for base,environment,override,expected in cases:
  originals=copy.deepcopy((base,environment,override)); result=merge(base,environment,override)
  ok=ok and result==expected and (base,environment,override)==originals
except Exception: ok=False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
try:
    result = subprocess.run(['python3', 'tests.py'], cwd='/tmp/config/project', capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False)
    actual = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
    saved = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in Path('/tmp/config/project/test.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if line.strip())
    ok = result.returncode == 0 and actual == '7 passed' and saved == actual
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY
